name: card
title: Card
description: Raised surfaces with images, titles, actions, a reveal panel, horizontal layout and fixed sizes.
improvements: The reveal activator is a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls instead of a clickable span.
Opening the reveal moves focus into the panel; Escape or the close button closes it and returns focus to the activator.
The hidden reveal panel is inert, so keyboard users never tab into invisible content.
Reveal state can be controlled (open / onOpenChange) and the slide respects reduced motion.
Card, CardContent and the other static parts stay server components; only the reveal parts ship JavaScript.
